# PodPilot

PodPilot is a browser-based upload automation and listing workflow tool for print-on-demand sellers who use Redbubble and TeePublic.

PodPilot helps sellers prepare design listings, organize metadata, generate AI-assisted listing drafts, review listing text for trademark and safety risk, and manage browser-based upload queues.

Uploads run from the user's own browser session through the PodPilot Chrome extension. PodPilot is independent software and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or partnered with Redbubble or TeePublic.

## Who PodPilot Is For

* Print-on-demand sellers who publish designs on Redbubble.
* Print-on-demand sellers who publish designs on TeePublic.
* Sellers who want to prepare listing metadata and upload queues before publishing.
* Sellers who want browser-based workflow help without giving PodPilot their marketplace passwords.

## What PodPilot Does

* Imports design files and listing metadata for batch review.
* Helps generate titles, descriptions, and tags for print-on-demand listings.
* Supports Redbubble and TeePublic upload workflows.
* Uses browser-based automation for repeated form-filling and upload queue management.
* Provides trademark and safety checks as informational review tools.
* Stores uploaded designs temporarily for 20 days before automatic deletion.

## What PodPilot Does Not Do

* PodPilot does not own or operate Redbubble or TeePublic.
* PodPilot does not guarantee marketplace approval, ranking, sales, or account outcomes.
* PodPilot does not publish content without the seller reviewing and starting the workflow.
* PodPilot does not replace a seller's responsibility to follow marketplace, trademark, copyright, and content rules.

## Pricing

PodPilot pricing is available at https://podpilot.space/pricing.

Subscription plans:

* Redbubble Plan: $4.99/month, or $49.90/year when annual billing is available. Includes Redbubble upload automation, Redbubble listing workflow tools, AI listing tools, trademark checks, and browser-based upload queue support for Redbubble.
* TeePublic Plan: $4.99/month, or $49.90/year when annual billing is available. Includes TeePublic upload automation, TeePublic listing workflow tools, AI listing tools, trademark checks, and browser-based upload queue support for TeePublic.
* All Platforms Plan: $6.99/month, or $69.90/year when annual billing is available. Includes both Redbubble and TeePublic workflows in one PodPilot account.

AI Listing credit add-ons:

* 250 AI Listing Credits: $1.99
* 500 AI Listing Credits: $2.99
* 1,000 AI Listing Credits: $4.99
* 2,500 AI Listing Credits: $11.99
* 5,000 AI Listing Credits: $21.99
* 10,000 AI Listing Credits: $39.99

All plans are designed for print-on-demand sellers who want to prepare listings, review metadata, check potential trademark risk, and run browser-based upload workflows for supported marketplaces.
